General release expressly excludes the earned-commission claim, since the $18,400 in owed commissions is being paid as wages.
Company will provide a neutral reference limited to dates of employment, job title, and eligibility for rehire, memorialized directly in the settlement agreement.
Former manager's record will reflect eligibility for rehire, consistent with the business-unit president's authorization condition.

Draft mediation memo must be updated before next week's mediation to reflect the $18,400 wage versus $33,600 release split, the exclusion of the earned-commission claim from the general release, and the neutral reference and rehire-eligibility terms.
